name: Path to Ascension: joining the rated 2v2 solo queue verifies Arena Solo Queue
contract: Arena Solo Queue (23), any class and game mode, reads 'Join a 2v2 Arena Game using the Solo Queue function.'. The Ascension PvP window's Rated SoloQ buttons send 0x05C1 {u32 bracket, u32 role}: bracket 2 is the 2v2 solo queue and bracket 5 the 1v1 solo queue. A successful join gives the player a personal one-member arena team (slot 0 for 2v2, slot 2 for 1v1) and SMSG_BATTLEFIELD_STATUS (0x02D4) for queue slot 0 with the arena type (2 or 1), the rated flag and STATUS_WAIT_QUEUE (1). CMSG_BATTLEFIELD_PORT (0x02D5) with action 0 leaves the queue, answered by an empty status for that slot. Joining the 2v2 solo queue verifies Arena Solo Queue; joining the 1v1 solo queue does not, as it is not a 2v2 game.
